label: LoRa paired-code CRC16 research frame
about: Explicit empirical frame-family hypothesis: an even-sized paired-code body, a received big-endian reflected CRC16 (polynomial 0x1021, working initial 0x0399 by default), and a decoded complement-sum byte. CRC initialization is not uniquely identifiable from a single fixed length. Optional repair fills only invalid/unknown pairs, preserves the received CRC and requires both checks. Repaired or physically weak results remain candidates. No manufacturer, device or business identity is established.
paired_body_bytes: Encoded body bytes before the received CRC
paired_payload_xor: Manual XOR hypothesis after four prefix bytes
paired.sequence.wire: Constrained wire candidate; originals retained upstream
paired.sequence.application: Application bytes under the manual XOR hypothesis
paired.conclusion.strict: Unique raw content satisfies the declared application checks with zero observed PHY distance. Validation is limited to these relationships.
paired.conclusion.weak: Application checks constrain the content, but physical evidence, observation admission or uniqueness is incomplete. A disabled RMS or peak-concentration gate retains candidate status.
paired.conclusion.repaired: A finite pair repair satisfies the received CRC and inner sum. Original errors and every repair are retained; this is not a strict hard-decoder frame.
paired.conclusion.unresolved: No accepted application content was found in the declared retained candidate and repair scope.
paired.scope.wire: Empirical encoded-body CRC16 and decoded complement-sum relationships under the declared length, pair polarity and finite search. PHY payload CRC, business semantics and device identity are separate.
paired.scope.inner: Decoded bytes constrained by the encoded-body CRC and inner complement sum. Prefix, XOR and status layouts are explicit hypotheses, not identified business meanings.
paired.check.raw_crc: Received candidate CRC before pair repair
paired.check.line: Every pair is a permitted 01/10 code
paired.check.sum: Decoded bytes sum to zero modulo 256
paired.check.unique: Unique content within the declared retained scope
paired.field.crc_limit: Fixed-length captures alone do not uniquely distinguish initialization, final XOR and constant-prefix models.
paired.field.business_unknown: Business, manufacturer, device identity, field units and clock epoch remain unverified.
paired.issue.parameter: Enter an even body length and valid parameters for this complete empirical profile; the optional status layout requires 48 encoded body bytes.
paired.issue.repaired: A pair was inferred under the declared repair constraints; its original value is retained upstream.
paired.issue.ambiguous: The content is ambiguous, incomplete or not fully observed under these constraints.
paired.issue.pair_unknown: One or more corresponding pairs have no unique accepted decoded bit.
paired.field.profile: Empirical paired-code CRC16 and complement-sum relationship
paired.scope.repair_candidates: Retained repair inputs under the declared erasure bound
paired.scope.raw_candidates: Raw application-valid domain candidates within the declared grid
